info.title: Family
info.description: Report which sites of this farm stand as family to the site being asked — children, sisters, parent, descendants — each with a count of the pages it holds. Kinship is read from the name, so the answer depends on where the question is put.

get.description: Answers for the site the request arrives at, not for the farm as a whole: asked at a child site, sisters are that child's siblings. Unknown kinds are dropped rather than refused. Read-only. Every family is a neighbourhood, so the site you asked at is never among its own results — `farm` gives the other sites of the farm, not a census including yourself. For a plain list of everything that exists, including the origin, read x-fedwiki-farm.sites in the merged document.

parameters.name: kinds
parameters.description: Which families to gather, comma separated. Defaults to sisters.

200.description: One group per requested kind, each sorted by site name.

Roll.description: The gather, as seen from one site.

origin.description: The site the question was asked at.

parentDomain.description: The domain this site hangs from, empty at a farm root.

groups.description: One key per requested and recognised kind.
